relationships.rationale: Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) is the gold standard psychological treatment for OCD, with strong evidence from randomized controlled trials.
Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, particularly when combined with ERP, is effective for OCD treatment.
SSRIs, including sertraline, are FDA-approved first-line medications for OCD. Higher doses are often needed compared to depression treatment.
Fluvoxamine is FDA-approved specifically for OCD and has strong evidence supporting its efficacy.

relationships.displayLabel: Find psychiatrists who may treat OCD
relationships.rationale: Connects users to psychiatrist directory with appropriate expectation setting about data limitations.
OCD was historically classified as an anxiety disorder. Users may benefit from understanding related conditions.

_comments.assessmentNote: No OCD-specific assessment (Y-BOCS) is currently available in the HeyPsych assessment library. The prompt specifies not to present unrelated assessments as OCD screeners. A 'questions to discuss with a professional' approach is used instead until a valid OCD assessment is added.
_comments.toolsNote: Tools tagged for OCD/anxiety will be shown dynamically via ToolService.getByCondition(). No manual tool relationships needed here.
_comments.providerNote: Find Care links use conservative language ('may treat') because NPPES data cannot substantiate OCD expertise.
